guides.intro: What an Arms warrior presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. A warrior has no mana: every attack costs rage, and rage comes from hitting and being hit. The whole game is spending it on the right attack. You stay in Battle Stance with a two-handed weapon from 1 to 60. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Heroic Strike
stages.change: **Heroic Strike** turns rage into a harder next swing.
press: Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Heroic Strike** whenever you have the rage for it.
notes: Stay in **Battle Stance**. Use a two-handed weapon from the first one you find.

stages.title: Charge and Rend
stages.change: **Charge** opens every fight with free rage and a stun. **Rend** is a bleed you apply once.
press: **Charge** to open every fight.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
**Heroic Strike** with the rage you have left.
notes: **Thunder Clap** (6) is for two or more mobs. **Hamstring** (8) stops a mob that runs away.

stages.title: Bloodrage, and talents begin
stages.change: **Bloodrage** gives you rage before you **Charge**. Talent points start.
press: **Bloodrage** while you are above 45% of your health, then **Charge** in.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
**Heroic Strike** with the rage you have left.
notes: **Defensive Stance**, **Taunt** and **Sunder Armor** (10) are for tanking. Arms levels in **Battle Stance**.
**Improved Rend** (10-12) is why the one **Rend** per mob is worth its rage.

stages.title: Overpower
stages.change: **Overpower** lights up when the mob dodges: a cheap hit that cannot be dodged. Keep rage for it.
press: **Bloodrage** while you are above 45% of your health, then **Charge** in.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage. Keep 15 back for **Overpower**.
notes: **Improved Overpower** (15-16) and **Improved Charge** (17-18) make both buttons better. Nothing new to press.
**Shield Bash** (12) and **Revenge** (14) need a shield or Defensive Stance. Skip them.

stages.title: Victory Rush
stages.change: **Victory Rush** is a free strike after each kill. Open the next fight with it when you are hurt.
press: **Bloodrage** while you are above 45% of your health, then **Charge** in. Open with **Victory Rush** when it is up and you are below 90% of your health.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage. Keep 15 back for **Overpower**.
notes: **Slam** (20): leave it off your bar until **Improved Slam** at 35. **Cleave** (20) is for two or more mobs.
**Deep Wounds** (20-22) adds a bleed to every critical hit. Nothing to press.

stages.title: Execute
stages.change: **Execute** finishes a mob below 20% health. From then on it comes first.
press: **Bloodrage** while you are above 45% of your health, then **Charge** in. Open with **Victory Rush** when it is up and you are below 90% of your health.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Execute** first, once the mob is below 20% of its health.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
**Heroic Strike** with spare rage. Keep 15 back for **Overpower**.
notes: **Bloodthrill** (30-31) also lights **Overpower** up while your **Rend** ticks. From 30 you press **Overpower** three times as often.
**Berserker Stance** (30) and **Intercept** (30) are not part of this rotation. Stay in **Battle Stance**.

stages.title: Slam
stages.change: **Improved Slam** (talent) makes **Slam** the better use of spare rage, ahead of Heroic Strike.
press: **Bloodrage** while you are above 45% of your health, then **Charge** in. Open with **Victory Rush** when it is up and you are below 90% of your health.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Execute** first, once the mob is below 20% of its health.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
Spare rage: **Slam**, then **Heroic Strike**. Keep 15 back for **Overpower**.
notes: **Whirlwind** (36) needs **Berserker Stance**. This rotation never leaves **Battle Stance**.
**Sweeping Strikes** (39) is for a second mob: press it, then **Thunder Clap** and **Cleave**.

stages.title: Mortal Strike, the finished rotation
stages.change: **Mortal Strike** (talent): your main attack from here to 60, whenever it is ready.
press: **Bloodrage** while you are above 45% of your health, then **Charge** in. Open with **Victory Rush** when it is up and you are below 90% of your health.
Keep **Battle Shout** up.
**Execute** first, once the mob is below 20% of its health.
**Overpower** whenever it lights up.
**Mortal Strike** whenever it is ready.
**Rend** once, while the mob has more than a third of its health.
Spare rage: **Slam**, then **Heroic Strike**. Keep 15 back for **Overpower**, and 30 more when **Mortal Strike** is almost ready.
notes: The remaining points go to Fury: **Cruelty** (41-45) for critical hits, **Unbridled Wrath** (47-50) and **Enrage** (52-56) for rage and damage.
Two or more mobs: **Sweeping Strikes**, then **Thunder Clap** and **Cleave**.

between: Bandage when you are below 60% of your health. Keep First Aid trained: it is a warrior's main way to recover.
Eat when you are below 40% of your health. That is the tuned rule for Arms.
Visit the trainer every even level. **Heroic Strike** and **Rend** have many ranks.
other: Fury with a weapon in each hand, and Protection for a warrior who wants to arrive at 60 as a tank, have their own pages in this folder.
Pulling two mobs at a time works from 39 with **Sweeping Strikes**. Before that, one at a time is faster and safer.
